title: VoiceDesign
description: A deterministic voice identity, composed once from a hash of the character id (ported from gamentic's voice-design composer). Provider-agnostic natural-language parameters a TTS adapter reads; the same id always yields the same voice, and a cast is composed with an exclude set so members sound distinct. Embedded verbatim into NpcDef.voiceDesign.

description.description: A one-line natural-language voice descriptor the TTS provider consumes.
